config-json.d: The checkpoint file that describes the architecture: dimensions, number and type of layers, experts, RoPE, declared quantization and extras. The inference engine reads the fields by name to build the tensor shapes and pick kernels.

grupo-kv.d: In vLLM's hybrid KV manager, a set of layers of the same type (full attention, window, Mamba-style state, indexer cache, drafter) that use the same number of blocks per request. All groups share a single page size.

model-registry.d: The vLLM table that maps the name in architectures (and the model_type) of the config to the Python module and class that implement the model. A new model has to be registered, or come in through a plugin/overlay.

hf-overrides.d: vLLM flag that merges a JSON dictionary into the Hugging Face config before building the model. Useful for fixing fields (heads at TP=3, dtype of the N-gram table, YaRN), but it only descends into nested configs that exist: in Qwen the override has to go inside text_config.

parametros-ativos.d: The parameters actually used to process one token. In an MoE: the dense part plus the top-k experts of each layer. Memory follows the total; the weight FLOPs (≈ 2 × active) and the bytes read in decode follow the active count. Model cards use different conventions for the embedding and the lm_head.

linhagem-arquitetural.d: The family of models and ideas an architecture descends from (e.g., DeepSeek-V2's 512 MLA latent → GLM-5.3-Flash, without RoPE, and DeepSeek-V4). It helps predict which kernels and engine paths already exist for a new model.

hash-routing.d: MoE routing by a fixed table: in DeepSeek-V4's layers 0–2, each token's 6 experts come from tid2eid[token_id], with no router GEMM for the selection. It requires the input_ids in the forward pass.

dspark.d: The built-in drafter of DeepSeek-V4-Flash (0731 and Vision-Exp): it reads the average of the 4 streams of layers 40–42, solves an [anchor + noise] block in a single forward pass through 3 SWA+MoE stages and uses a rank-256 Markov head to sample the sequence.

dflash2.d: GLM-5.3-Flash's external 1.17 B-parameter drafter, in the block-diffusion style: it reads the outputs of 5 layers of the target and predicts 7 positions at once, with bidirectional attention within the block, top-16 candidates and a bilinear selector.
